Enums, Generics, Exceptions & Immutability for LLD

The seven small language tools that make a machine-coding answer look senior: rich enums, generics, a typed exception tree, Optional, immutable value objects, a correct equals/hashCode pair, and Comparator chains. Each one is shown first as a story, then as Java 21 code you can run.

sections.title: From kitchen habits to Java tools
Rich enums: constants that carry data and behaviour
Optional: say "maybe absent" in the type
equals and hashCode: the contract behind every HashMap
Comparable and Comparator: ordering rules as objects
All seven together: one runnable file
Bonus: sealed interfaces and pattern matching (Java 17-21)
